basic_info.description: Set in a prized location in sought-after Lone Mountain, this rare three-level residence reflects generations of pride in ownership, enhanced by thoughtful system updates. Graceful archways seamlessly connect the living room, dining area, and a charming breakfast nook, creating an airy, light-filled ambiance. Two generously proportioned bedrooms are perfectly situated at the rear of the main level, overlooking a level yard framed by a lush privacy tree, an ideal setting for outdoor entertaining. The expansive top floor is dedicated entirely to a remarkable primary suite, featuring a voluminous bedroom with peekaboo ocean views and stunning sunsets over the city. A spacious walk-in closet, ensuite bath, and sunroom retreat complete this tranquil sanctuary. On the ground level, a full-floor garage with soaring ceilings offers excellent expansion potential perfect for additional living space or future flexibility. With updated systems, including electrical, the home is move-in ready yet invites your personal vision. Moments from Rossi Park & Pool, Golden Gate Park, Koret Center, USF, and convenient public transit, this is a rare opportunity to own a timeless Lone Mountain home that offers scale, serenity, and possibility in equal measure.
